result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional `description`, and it comes back from all the listing methods and from the code lookup. The full suite passes offline (608 tests, including a new one).

What changed:
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: new last record component `description`, null when none was given.
- **`schema.sql`**: nullable `description VARCHAR(200)` column on `promotion`. The database is built fresh in memory, so there is no migration.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: new 6-argument `createPromotion(..., category, description)`. A null or blank description is stored as null. The existing 5-argument method stays and delegates with no description, so the roughly 80 existing call sites are untouched.
- **`DataStore.java`**: `createPromotion` writes the column. Every promotion query now selects `description` and passes it to the record. That covers the active-on-date, active-in-region, by-category, best-for-category, unused-in-period and find-by-code queries.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: new `keepsDescriptionInEveryListing` test. It checks the SUMMER description in the code lookup, the active and category listings, and that a promotion without one shows null.

Nothing is committed. The `sed -i` shell calls were blocked, so I made the `DataStore` edits with the edit tool instead.
